name: CUDA-OpenGL Interop Surface Write
aliases: CUDA-OpenGL Interop Surface Write — Direct GL Texture Write from CUDA
Direct GL Texture Write from CUDA
definition: Writes directly to an OpenGL texture from a CUDA kernel using CUDA graphics interop, avoiding intermediate device buffers.
summary: CUDA-OpenGL Interop Surface Write lets CUDA kernels directly update OpenGL 3D textures, avoiding intermediate buffers and bulk copies used by texture copy methods.
